lines.text: Your child's first Qur'an lesson is not a test.
lines.phonemes: jˌʊɹ ʧˈIldz fˈɜɹst kʊɹˈɑn lˈɛsən ɪz nˌɑt ɐ tˈɛst.

lines.text: They don't need to prepare. Mistakes simply show the teacher where to begin.
lines.phonemes: ðˌA dˈOnt nˈid tə pɹipˈɛɹ. məstˈAks sˈɪmpli ʃˈO ðə tˈiʧəɹ wˌɛɹ tə bəɡˈɪn.

lines.text: In a trial lesson, here are four things to notice.
lines.phonemes: ˌɪn ɐ tɹˈIᵊl lˈɛsən, hˈɪɹ ɑɹ fˈɔɹ θˈɪŋz tə nˈOɾəs.

lines.text: One. Does the teacher speak to your child, clearly and with respect?
lines.phonemes: wˈʌn. dˈʌz ðə tˈiʧəɹ spˈik tə jʊɹ ʧˈIld, klˈɪɹli ænd wɪð ɹəspˈɛkt?

lines.text: Two. Does the teacher listen first, before deciding what to teach?
lines.phonemes: tˈu. dˈʌz ðə tˈiʧəɹ lˈɪsᵊn fˈɜɹst, bəfˈɔɹ dəsˈIdɪŋ wˌʌt tə tˈiʧ?

lines.text: Three. Does your child feel safe to try again after a mistake?
lines.phonemes: θɹˈi. dˈʌz jʊɹ ʧˈIld fˈil sˈAf tə tɹˈI əɡˈɛn ˈæftəɹ ɐ məstˈAk?

lines.text: Four. Is it clear what your child should work on next?
lines.phonemes: fˈɔɹ. ˌɪz ɪt klˈɪɹ wˌʌt jʊɹ ʧˈIld ʃˌʊd wˈɜɹk ˌɔn nˈɛkst?

lines.text: At Tarteel House, you can see all of this for yourself.
lines.phonemes: ˌæt tɑɹtˈil hˈWs, ju kæn sˈi ˈɔl ʌv ðɪs fɔɹ jəɹsˈɛlf.

lines.text: The first lesson is free. Forty minutes, one-to-one, with no payment.
lines.phonemes: ðə fˈɜɹst lˈɛsən ɪz fɹˈi. fˈɔɹɾi mˈɪnəts, wˌʌntəwˈʌn, wɪð nˈO pˈAmᵊnt.
